prompt: RimWorld top-down animal sprite, painterly vanilla-RimWorld creature art style: a long, serpentine submerged predator with no limbs, a narrow wedge-shaped head with small fangs, a sinuous body tapering to a flat propulsive tail, built for cutting fast through liquid. Slick, dark obsidian-black hide with faint oily blue-violet iridescence along the spine, like a film of fuel catching light. Body coiled in a low forward-striking S-curve, mostly submerged with only the head and a sliver of back breaking the surface, a thin V-shaped ripple wake trailing behind it on a black mirror-like liquid surface, facing and swimming toward the right of frame. Viewed from directly above at a slight isometric RimWorld camera angle, centered, a short soft shadow beneath it, no background scenery beyond a hint of dark liquid surface. Heavy, clean black outline around the whole silhouette and all major internal linework, thick enough to read clearly at standard RimWorld zoom and below.
